name: DayTidy
author: Webilia Inc.

sections.description:
DayTidy is a WordPress booking plugin for appointments, events, classes, tours, services, and dining reservations. Publish what people can book, define when it is available, and manage reservations from your WordPress dashboard. Use it for a consultation schedule, recurring workshop, guided tour, or service that depends on available staff or equipment.

A bookable item is called an offering. Each offering brings together its public details, sessions, ticket or service choices, and booking form. Start with one offering and test the complete customer journey before opening bookings to visitors.

Build a schedule around your offering

Create one-time or recurring sessions and configure their duration and recurrence limits. For example, a class can run on a repeating schedule while a workshop has a single session. Organize offerings with categories, locations, hosts, tags, labels, and agenda content when the relevant modules are enabled.

Use ticket or service options to present the choices customers can reserve. Configure the booking and participant forms with the details you need, required fields, conditional display, and offering-specific overrides. Check your saved sessions and options together so the booking form presents the intended choices.

Match bookings to available resources

DayTidy Free includes reusable global resources for staff, rooms, equipment, and other constrained assets. Set weekly hours, availability exceptions, capacity rules, and preparation or cleanup buffers. Resource availability is evaluated alongside the offering’s sessions and booking requirements.

For resource-based bookings, configure an eligible pool for automatic assignment or customer selection. Each selected ticket or service option that requires a resource receives one resource assignment; selecting a pool does not reserve every resource in it. Existing reserving bookings, including Pending bookings, can reduce available capacity. These controls let you model a consultation with an available specialist or a service using shared equipment.

Give visitors a route from discovery to booking

Display offerings in list, grid, or calendar views. The public calendar provides month, week, and day views so visitors can browse sessions by date. Save a view and place its shortcode on a WordPress page, or embed the booking form for an individual offering. Generated offering pages are also available according to the Offering Page settings.

Customers choose the available options and sessions, enter the requested information, and follow the configured payment workflow. Free supports free bookings, on-site payment, and wire-transfer instructions. Offline methods require staff to collect and reconcile payment; they do not charge a customer automatically. Check the final payable amount when configuring a free booking.

Manage reservations and keep customers informed

Review booking records with separate booking and payment states, create manual bookings, and reschedule eligible reservations as an administrator. The customer portal gives authorized customers access to their bookings and reservation details. Customers can cancel eligible bookings within your configured policy and deadline; customer self-rescheduling is not included, and cancellation does not automatically refund payment.

Free includes lifecycle email templates, recipient settings, placeholders, attachments, iCal attachments, and test sends. Delivery requires working WordPress mail transport. Private ICS subscriptions cover all bookings, one offering, or one resource; these are subscription feeds with client-controlled refresh, rather than two-way external calendar synchronization. Filtered booking CSV export is available with the required permissions.

Extend your workflow with DayTidy Pro

DayTidy Pro is a separate paid extension that requires active DayTidy Free, enabled modules, and authorization through eligible Webilia Connect access or an independent license code. Optional Pro capabilities include:

  • Stripe, PayPal Standard, and WooCommerce Cart online checkout, with provider configuration required.
  • Eligible Stripe/PayPal charge refunds through Online Refunds; external refund recording is available in Free.
  • Percentage or fixed coupons with validity periods and usage limits.
  • Scheduled reminders, delivery logs, and eligible recipient retries.
  • Advanced report panels, customer CSV export, and the administrator booking calendar.
  • Frontend offering management, plus offering-owned resources with Resource Groups.
  • Presenter profiles, sponsors, and fallback-image controls.

Only WooCommerce Cart requires WooCommerce. Pro authorization does not configure payment providers, and individual features still require their modules and permissions.

Useful links

  • Documentation
  • Getting started
  • DayTidy Pro
  • Support

Privacy

DayTidy stores booking and customer information in your WordPress database so site owners can manage bookings and provide support. DayTidy integrates with WordPress personal-data export and erasure tools. Booking records are retained by default during erasure requests; the site owner decides whether records should be deleted or anonymized based on their obligations.

Third-Party Services

DayTidy requests cached product announcements from Webilia. This request sends the site URL and active DayTidy plugin basenames to the announcements service. It does not include booking or customer information.

An administrator may also choose to submit deactivation feedback. Only when Submit & Deactivate is selected, DayTidy sends the site URL, plugin identifier, selected reason, and optional comments. Skip and Cancel do not submit feedback.

When an administrator connects Webilia Connect or activates or validates a manual Pro license, DayTidy Free communicates with Webilia services for account authorization and licensing. Free links to My Webilia for Pro downloads; install and activate Pro through the WordPress Plugins screen. When separately installed and active, DayTidy Pro handles its own update checks and package delivery. Depending on the action, this may send the website URL, product identifiers and versions, connection verification data, or a supplied license code. Booking and customer data are not sent to these services.

  • Free services: https://api.webilia.com/ (announcements and licensing) and https://my.webilia.com/ (account authorization and Pro downloads).
  • Separately installed Pro: https://api.webilia.com/ (updates) and https://cdn.webilia.com/ (package delivery).
  • Deactivation feedback: https://api.webilia.com/deactivation-feedback
  • Privacy Policy: https://webilia.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms and Conditions: https://webilia.com/terms-and-conditions/

Source and Build Tools

The plugin includes its JavaScript and SCSS sources in assets/src/, together with package.json, package-lock.json, and webpack configurations. Compiled browser assets are in assets/dist/.

To rebuild the browser assets, use Node.js 22 and npm. From the plugin directory, run npm ci, then npm run build. This regenerates assets/dist/. Lint and browser test configurations are development-only and are not included in this release.

PHP runtime dependencies and their licenses are bundled in vendor/ and identified by composer.json. WordPress users do not need to run Composer or npm to use DayTidy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the DayTidy ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Review DayTidy > Settings for date/time, currency, and enabled modules.
  3. Open DayTidy > Offerings > Add New Offering. Add details, future sessions, and ticket/service options. Configure resources when needed.
  4. Publish and check the public offering page, or add [daytidy-booking id=”OFFERING_ID”] to a WordPress Shortcode block. Replace OFFERING_ID with the offering’s post ID.
  5. Publish a collection under DayTidy > Views and embed [daytidy id=”VIEW_ID”]. View and offering IDs differ.
  6. For customer access, publish a page with [daytidy-customer-portal], select it under DayTidy > Settings > Booking, and review cancellation settings.
  7. Test with controlled details/recipients and provider test credentials. Verify sessions, options, resources, and booking/payment states under DayTidy > Bookings.
sections.faq:
Can bookings be free?

Yes. Set the ticket/service price to zero and check the final payable total after fees and taxes.

Do I need Pro or WooCommerce?

Free works without either. Pro adds Stripe, PayPal Standard, and WooCommerce Cart checkout. Only the Cart approach requires WooCommerce; configure its gateways separately. Free’s on-site/wire methods do not collect money automatically.

How do I display a booking form or calendar?

Use the booking/view shortcodes in Installation with the correct saved post IDs. A generated offering page depends on its Offering Page mode.

Can customers cancel or reschedule?

Authorized customers can cancel eligible reservations within the configured policy and deadline. Administrators handle rescheduling; customer self-rescheduling is not included. Cancellation does not automatically refund payment.

Can one service reserve several resources together?

When resources are required, each selected ticket/service option is assigned one resource. An eligible pool allows automatic assignment or customer choice, not reservation of every resource together.

Does DayTidy synchronize external calendars?

Free provides private ICS subscriptions with client-controlled refresh. These do not provide two-way account sync or import external busy time. Keep URLs private; scope, date, and volume limits apply.

Do emails require Pro?

Lifecycle templates and test sends are Free. Reminders, delivery logs, and eligible retries require Pro. Working mail transport is required; accepted sends do not prove inbox delivery.

Why is a slot unavailable?

Check sessions, timezone, quantities, resource eligibility, hours, exceptions, buffers, and reserving bookings, including Pending. See availability troubleshooting.

Does Pro replace Free?

No. Keep both active. Installation, Pro authorization, and provider configuration are separate steps.

Will uninstalling delete my data?

Data is kept by default. Full cleanup requires Delete data on uninstall under DayTidy > Settings > General > Uninstall Data Retention. Leave it disabled for updates/troubleshooting; back up before cleanup.

Where can I get help?

Use the links above. Redact customer details, credentials, and private feed URLs from diagnostics.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Feature: Book multiple services with independent appointment times and resource choices, or arrange appointments back to back.
  • Feature: Offer opt-in assistant access to offering discovery, availability searches, pricing, and eligible free or pay-on-site guest bookings.
  • Feature: Allow guests to verify and cancel eligible bookings through separately enabled assistant access.
  • Feature: Add telephone fields to booking, participant, and offering forms with mobile keypad and autofill support.
  • Feature: Access DayTidy news, documentation, and support from a WordPress Dashboard widget.
  • Improvement: Customize booking embeds with form-only layouts, step introduction visibility, and numbered horizontal or responsive vertical progress.
  • Improvement: Launch the Offering Wizard directly from the Offerings list and retain unfinished inputs when closing and reopening it.
  • Improvement: Show clearer appointment summaries, resource choices, calendar today markers, and loading feedback, with better mobile layouts and color contrast.
  • Improvement: Adapt list, grid, and calendar views to the width of their page container.
  • Improvement: Manage guest booking, cancellation, verification, and security controls from the AI Agents section beside Settings.
  • Improvement: Customize guest booking and cancellation verification emails while preserving the required verification code.
  • Fix: Display special characters correctly in offering titles, summaries, taxonomy names, and customer portal text.
  • Fix: Select newly created taxonomy terms automatically while preserving existing primary selections and form values.
  • Fix: Validate recurring schedules before saving and align their first occurrences between the editor and generated calendars.
  • Fix: Keep customer portal content inside its page container and avoid extra scrollbars in embedded booking forms.
  • Fix: Prevent duplicate Settings save messages and preserve usable spacing in long module dialogs.

1.0.1

  • Improvement: Faster offering pages, service calendars, and booking steps for offerings with many recurring sessions or multiple services.
  • Improvement: Cleaner dashboard presentation and consistent spacing between admin notices and page content.
  • Fix: Display ampersands and other special characters correctly in form fields and offering details.
  • Fix: Align calendar weekday headings with their dates and keep time-slot headings consistently bold.
  • Fix: Use each service’s configured duration in time-slot labels, selected-session summaries, and checkout summaries, including selections across calendar months.
  • Fix: Preserve WordPress’s red styling for delete actions and keep deactivation dialog close icons visible.
  • Fix: Direct documentation and support links to the correct DayTidy pages.

1.0.0

  • Publish offerings with one-time and recurring schedules.
  • Accept free and offline bookings, manage booking records, and reschedule bookings.
  • Provide customer booking access and policy-controlled cancellation.
  • Display offering pages, list, grid, and calendar views, and embedded booking forms.
  • Add configurable notifications, calendar subscriptions, booking exports, and diagnostics.
  • Support optional DayTidy Pro authorization through Webilia Connect or independent license codes.
  • Preserve business data on uninstall unless an administrator explicitly enables cleanup.

screenshots.caption: Online booking - choose sessions and available times for the selected booking option.
Offering grid - display bookable offerings in a card layout.
Offering list - display upcoming offering sessions in a list layout.
Offering calendar - browse offering sessions in month, week, or day views.
Offering schedules - configure recurring sessions, duration, and recurrence limits. Presenter and sponsor controls shown require DayTidy Pro.
View builder - configure list, grid, or calendar displays and copy the saved view shortcode.
Booking management - filter reservations and review booking and payment statuses. The Calendar tab requires DayTidy Pro.
Customer portal - customers can review their authorized bookings and open reservation details.
Payment settings - configure free and offline payment methods. Stripe, PayPal Standard, and WooCommerce Cart require DayTidy Pro.
Frontend dashboard - view and manage offerings you own or are authorized to edit (DayTidy Pro).
Frontend dashboard - create a new offering outside wp-admin (DayTidy Pro).
Frontend dashboard - manage offering-owned resources and weekly availability (DayTidy Pro with Resource Groups).
